// Tiles a spatial shape on a lattice with the given period per axis. Counts
// bounds the repetitions per axis; a non-positive count means unbounded
// repetition along that axis.
type SdfRepetitionModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Period: Vector3D;
    Counts: IntegerVector3;
}
